subject.title: [Bug][iOS] chat.history reconciliation duplicates and reorders replies after tool runs

question: Is the released Gateway trace sufficient to sponsor a bounded native reconciliation fix now, or should the reporter first provide the offered screenshots and a redacted request/event timeline that an iOS owner can encode as a replay fixture?
rationale: The user impact is credible and urgent, but existing reconciliation guards make the exact failing interleaving important; choosing whether the current evidence is sufficient to begin implementation requires native-chat owner judgment.

options.title: Capture replay evidence first
options.body: Request the offered screenshots plus a redacted ordered timeline of final, session-message, and history request/response events, then encode that sequence before changing reconciliation.

options.title: Sponsor a bounded fix now
options.body: Accept the trace as sufficient and implement stale-history response rejection plus focused reverse-completion regression coverage without broad tool-rendering changes.

recommendation.title: Capture replay evidence first
recommendation.body: Request the offered screenshots plus a redacted ordered timeline of final, session-message, and history request/response events, then encode that sequence before changing reconciliation.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal connects this contributor to the shared native chat model, reconciliation tests, and iOS transport boundary.
